function.name: load_model
function.description: Initializes and returns a visual question answering pipeline with a specified model and device. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device.description: The device index to load the model on. A value of -1 indicates CPU, and non-negative values indicate the respective GPU index.

function.name: process_data
function.description: Extracts a question from a text file, processes an image, and uses a Visual Question Answering (VQA) pipeline to generate an answer. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

file_path.description: The file system path to the text file containing the question. For example, '/path/to/question.txt'.

image_path.description: The file system path to the image file. For example, '/path/to/image.jpg'.

vqa_pipeline.description: The VQA pipeline function that takes an image and a question as input and returns a list with a dictionary containing the answer.
